messages:
maria: Heads-up — Acme security questionnaire live call at 15:00 PT. I’m on the review thread and they want clarity on RBAC changes + KMS envelope handoff.
josh: I’ll join. Do we have a short checklist we can run through? They like step-by-step proofs.
samir: Quick note: Acme asked specifically for an example of a user provisioning flow, including service account creation and audit log evidence.
alex: We should be prepared to show both hosted and on-prem behavior. Hosted: org-admin creates role -> grants -> audit entry. On-prem: local LDAP sync + HSM key unwrap example.
maria: Proposed tiny agenda: 1) RBAC model and recent change to allow cross-tenant read-only roles, 2) KMS envelope lifecycle + KMS rotation policy, 3) audit logging retention & export, 4) incident response hooks. Agree?
josh: 👍 Agree. Samir can you assemble the minimal evidence snippets (log lines + sample API calls)?
samir: On it. I’ll paste examples in-thread for the call so we can screenshare instead of hunting during the call.
security-bot: [alert] New customer questionnaire assigned: ACME-2026-03-20-SQ. Due: 2026-03-27.
maria: FYI — requestor wants proof of log immutability for 90 days and proof of KMS key access pattern (who executed decrypts). We have to show SIEM export + KMS audit trail.
alex: For KMS audit, we can show a redacted snippet from our CloudKMS/HSM audit logs. Example:
```json
{"timestamp":"2026-03-19T22:14:02Z","principal":"svc-redwood-inference@acme-prod","action":"crypto.decrypt","key_id":"projects/p/locations/global/keyRings/r/keys/customer-enc-01","result":"SUCCESS"}
```
maria: Perfect. Add a 2-line explanation: we never expose plaintext keys, envelope keys are wrapped by customer-managed keys when on Private.
josh: RBAC change note: we added a cross-tenant read-only grant for support engineers with strict scoping and time-limited sessions. Control plane still enforces tenant isolation at runtime. We should have the feature flag name and a link to the rollout doc.
samir: Rollout doc link (internal): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rbac-cross-tenant-readonly — include the canary dates and rollback steps.
ops-bot: deploy:rbac-service v2.4.1 deployed to canary at 2026-03-18T08:03:21Z by josh.
maria: During call, if they ask for e2e proof, show the following sequence (screenshare):
  - create temporary support role iam:CreateRole + grant
  - call to /v1/tenants/{t}/keys to fetch key metadata (no plaintext)
  - KMS decrypt call appears in audit log
  - SIEM export shows immutable log snapshot for that timestamp
alex: Quick snippet to show for API evidence:
```
POST /v1/roles
{ "name": "support-readonly-temp", "scope": "tenant:acme-prod", "expires_at":"2026-03-20T16:00:00Z" }
```
josh: If they press on key rotation proof, show rotation policy: automatic yearly rotation by default, manual rotation with audit event, and a sample timeline for a rotated key.
samir: Also prepare answer for: "Can you revoke access during an incident?" Quick answer: yes — revoke role, revoke session tokens, and rotate envelope key; all actions emit audit events and trigger alerting rules.
maria: Action items before call:
  - samir: paste redacted audit snippets + canonical API calls (in-thread) — due 14:30 PT
  - alex: prepare slides showing hosted vs private KMS flow — due 14:45 PT
  - josh: have rollout doc open and link short checklist for RBAC rollback — due 14:50 PT
  - ops-bot: ensure canary logs retained longer for the proof window — please confirm
ops-bot: retention:logs extended to 180 days for canary project acme-proof at 2026-03-19T14:05:12Z.
josh: One more edge question they love: log chain proofs for tamper-detection. We have automated signed log snapshots — show signature header and verify command:
```
# verify snapshot
logctl verify --snapshot snapshot-id --public-key /tmp/redwood-signed-pub.pem
```
maria: Good. Keep replies concise during the call. I’ll start the meeting with a 2-min overview and then hand off to Samir for evidence. Thanks all — I’ll post a short recording + artifacts after.
security-bot: meeting: ACME SQ Live Call (recurring) scheduled 2026-03-20T15:00:00Z. Recording enabled.
samir: Paste of redacted audit snippet (example):
{"ts":"2026-03-19T22:14:02Z","actor":"svc-redwood-inference@acme-prod","event":"kms.decrypt","role":"support-readonly-temp","outcome":"SUCCESS","metadata":"redacted"}

samir: And a redacted SIEM export line for the same event with immutability hash:
{"snapshot_id":"snap-20260319-2214","hash":"ab12...ef34","events":1}

maria: Perfect — this is ready. See you in 15. :thumbsup:
